steps: Recompute the a-insensitivity Spearman rho (Part1 vs Part2) for the control and TP groups from the raw per-subject a-values.
Reconcile the text (Section 4.2) with the Figure 2 captions; correct whichever of 0.73/0.74 vs 0.77/0.70 is wrong (most likely a figure-caption copy-paste from Figure 1).
If a re-typeset or erratum is warranted, log the corrected correlation in the Supplement.
Archive the anonymised per-subject matching-probability dataset (Parts 0/1/2, all events, TP/control flags, response times) plus cleaning and regression code.
Deposit in the Econometric Society Journals' Zenodo community (es-replication-repository) and add the package DOI to the manuscript/ERRATA.
Provide a README mapping every exhibit (Tables III-VI, SA-I.-SB-I, SC-I, Figs 1-2) to the producing script.
